name: AIStage

sources.title: Homepage — live AI tools directory (4,000+ tools, 230+ categories), 'Submit AI' nav link → /submit, 'Featured' and 'Just Launched' sections
Pricing page (search-indexed) — Basic Submit $9.9 (was $19.9), Featured Submit $19.9, Unlimited Submit $59.9/mo; all advertise 'DR 70+ dofollow backlinks' and 48h review
Third-party analysis — the free badge-for-listing tier was removed in Aug 2025; cheapest route is now $9.9 one-time

requirements: AI tool/website only — directory is exclusively AI products across 230+ categories
No free tier anymore: Basic Submit $9.9 one-time (listing + 'dofollow backlink' claim), Featured $19.9 one-time (homepage/featured placement 14 days), Unlimited $59.9/mo
preparation: Product name, URL, short description, logo/icon, pricing model tag (Free/Freemium/Free Trial/Paid)
Category choice across their AI taxonomy
Payment method — no free path verified
workflow: Open https://aistage.net/submit in a browser (403 to automated fetches)
Choose a tier — Basic $9.9 vs Featured $19.9 vs Unlimited $59.9/mo (prices per the indexed pricing page; verify live)
Review completes in ~48h; the listing gets a detail page on aistage.net
watchFor: Free tier was removed (Aug 2025 per third-party record) — don't trust old 'free submit' articles
Crossed-out anchor prices ($19.9→$9.9) are discount marketing; verify at checkout
'DR 70+ dofollow backlinks' is their claim, not independently verified
Unlimited tier is a subscription — cancel to avoid repeat billing
countsAsLive: The tool has a public detail page on aistage.net reachable from category/search and (for Featured) homepage placement
unknowns: Exact submission form fields (submit page bot-blocked)
Whether links are actually dofollow on live pages
